build_inceptionv3_for_fid: build a pretrained InceptionV3 model to extract 2048-d feature maps for FID score computation
build_inceptionv3_for_sketch: build a pretrained InceptionV3 model with sketch weights to extract features from grayscale images
extract_multi_block_features: extract feature maps from multiple InceptionV3 blocks by specifying output block indices 0 through 3
create_fid_inception_model: create a FID-compatible InceptionV3 model with patched InceptionA, InceptionC, and InceptionE blocks
create_sketch_inception_model: create a sketch-trained InceptionV3 model loaded from a custom checkpoint with single-channel input support
